official_challenge.dataset_boundary: The 2026 Track 1 official test consists of 200 eval.json samples (img and prompt), one generated video per sample. Both editions use VIP-200K training data, but the 2027 page describes 200 identities x five prompts = 1,000 test pairs. Training-source continuity does not establish identical test files or output specifications.

related_work.name: AESR: Identity-Preserving Text-to-Video Generation via Agentic Enhancement and Semantic Repair
related_work.competition: MM 2026 IPVG Track 1 joint first, not sole first
related_work.availability: Actual orchestration, playbooks, evaluation and repair scripts are present. Training-free API-oriented; no released trainable video checkpoint or training entry. The last provider video-edit call remains explicit in the example workflow.
related_work.license: No software license. README explicitly says source-available for inspection until authors add one.
related_work.reuse_boundary: Learn prompt enhancement, failure reflection, typed critique, keyframe repair and multi-candidate selection as research ideas; do not present the repository as a permissively licensed, local, training-ready winner model. Closed generation/editing providers mean reproducing the exact result needs their service access and costs.

related_work.name: Chronos: Sequential Identity-Preserving Video Generation by Temporal Anchoring
related_work.competition: MM 2026 Track 1 joint first and Track 2 first
related_work.availability: Official programme confirms title, authors and method abstract. An author-linked public code/checkpoint/training release was not verified in this audit.
related_work.method: Semantic prompt anchoring, visual frame anchoring and metric-guided routing among heterogeneous generators. Treat these as design references, not an available checkpoint.

related_work.name: KeyID: Decoupled Drafting and Keyframe Editing for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
related_work.competition: MM 2026 Track 2 second; not a verified Track 1 podium entry
related_work.availability: Repository tree contains README only; no executable pipeline, released weights or training entry.

related_work.name: IPVG-STD
related_work.availability: Prompt decomposition -> HyperLoRA identity first frame -> Wan2.2 generation scripts. No project training entry. README claims MIT, but no LICENSE file in audited tree.
related_work.reuse_boundary: Historical modular recipe; do not attribute the 2026 third-place team to this paper solely from a similar team name.

direct_base_order.name: Stand-In
direct_base_order.availability: Real identity adapter weights and inference, plus Wan2.1 VACE integration; training data/preprocessing/training code remain TODO. trainers/ contains only utility files.
direct_base_order.license: Apache-2.0 project and adapter card; upstream face-recognition models have separate terms.

direct_base_order.name: AnyID
direct_base_order.availability: Wan2.2 TI2V-5B preview LoRA with inference and merge scripts. Directory named trainer does not include an actual training or human-centric RL entry.

direct_base_order.name: ConsisID
direct_base_order.availability: train.py, train_single_rank.sh, train_multi_rank.sh, data preprocessing and evaluation exist. More complete for immediate identity-specific supervised fine-tuning than inference-only adapters.
direct_base_order.license: Majority Apache-2.0; CogVideoX transformer and third-party face weights retain their separate terms.

vace_position: VACE1.3B+DiffSynth remains useful as the existing trainable engineering/control baseline. It is not inherently a face-specialist and should not be promoted as a strong Track 1 identity baseline before comparison with Stand-In/AnyID/ConsisID.
verification: Read-only primary research plus local evidence files. No repository code edited, no weights downloaded and no model execution.
